scope: Read-only external-reference and acoustic inspection of already selected recordings. No AI inference run; no production edits; no recognition.json or alignment output read.
referenceStatus: No independently verified word/phone ground truth. Do not compute word start/end error in milliseconds against these observations.

versionVerification.methodRequired: Audio correlation between artist SoundCloud stream and official video audio, ideally across several separated windows. Matching title/duration alone is insufficient.
versionVerification.reason: Public official YouTube audio fetch returned HTTP429 and sign-in/anti-bot wall for all three clips. No authentication bypass attempted. No official-video audio exists locally for correlation.

antytila.trackType: subtitles, not automatic_captions, according to downloader metadata
antytila.usableFor: Checking candidate phrase text/coverage; not word error scoring or unverified clock transfer.

otorvald.status: No publisher subtitle track in retrieved metadata. Automatic captions are present but were not used as ground truth.

pivovarov.status: No publisher lyric subtitle track in retrieved metadata; live_chat is not lyric alignment.

lrclib.reason: Three structured API searches and one ASCII keyword query all returned HTTP502. Web retrieval of the search URLs was unavailable. This does not show that records do not exist.

acousticObservations.entryInterpretation: First clearly prominent changing harmonic/formant-like structure in the selected Demucs stem. Earlier low-energy tonal material is ambiguous; this range is not the first phoneme boundary.
acousticObservations.quietInterpretation: Interior of a visible low-energy gap in the stem, also separating prominent harmonic groups. Separation may suppress quiet voice; this is a phrase-level inspection aid, not silence ground truth.
acousticObservations.endReason: Weak tonal tail remains at the selected clip end34.2s. Available wider raw context extends to39.2s; the selected stem alone cannot settle the lexical end.
acousticObservations.captionMismatchExplanation: Could be display lead-in, quiet consonants, different clocks or versions. Without video audio correlation, no unique cause is established.

acousticObservations.entryInterpretation: Near-silent stem lead-in, then broadband material and changing harmonics. This bounds a probable vocal entry coarsely; it does not identify a word or phoneme.
acousticObservations.endReason: Strong changing harmonic/formant-like material continues at selected endpoint54.0s. This crop endpoint cannot be treated as a phrase-end reference; use retained context through59.0s to check complete textual coverage.

acousticObservations.entryReason: Strong vocal-like material begins almost immediately after the clip starts. The precise consonant/word onset is not established without interpreting earlier context.
acousticObservations.decayInterpretation: Prominent changing harmonic energy falls near the clip end. A small residual remains; lexical end versus reverb is unresolved. This is a broad signal decay range, not word-end ground truth.

limitations: Raw mixes contain instruments; Demucs can leave leakage or remove quiet endings. Neither source is sufficient to assign every phonetic boundary without further listening/annotation.
No exact timestamp was assigned where vocal identity or ending was ambiguous.
No ASR or CTC times were used to choose the reported acoustic ranges.
All original selection/candidate manifests remain unchanged; the observation file adds warnings rather than revising the test to favour an alignment outcome.
